rows.text: The communique dated 7 June 2024 states that an NDA delegation called on the President at 2.30 pm with a letter that Modi had been elected leader of the BJP Parliamentary Party and letters of support, and that the President, satisfied that the BJP-led NDA could command majority support in the 18th Lok Sabha, appointed Narendra Modi as the Prime Minister of India under Article 75(1) and asked him to indicate the date and time of the swearing-in and the names of other ministers.
